fresh_discovery_exports.use: controller ownership, selection, main update, range, trend and icon discovery only
transition refresh, decision aggregation/order and range materialization discovery only

exact20_authority_receipt.binding: A729_CONTROLLER_EXACT20_AUTHORITY_BOUND and A729_CONTROLLER_EXACT20_MANIFEST_SHA256 in the PBP2 carrier
exact20_authority_receipt.hook_abi: 0x141c4baa0 at RVA 0x01c4baa0, Windows x64 RCX=this/DL=full_refresh/R8B=range_refresh, sentinel 488bc44889581888501055565741544155, owner vtable RVA 0x02a421c0

selection_and_identity.selector: 0x140e424f0 scans 0x190-byte records in stored engine order and returns the first record whose country predicate passes
selection_and_identity.cardinality: The base-game panel has zero or one selected row for a country. It does not expose every applicable balance or later display ordinals.
selection_and_identity.stable_id_rule: Replace live definition pointers with the effective common/bop catalog ids in the observer epoch. Balance and side display-name lookup reads each definition token at +0x10 through 0x140a7e7b0; pointer values are never serialized.
selection_and_identity.active_side_rule: value < 0 selects record+0x18; value >= 0 selects record+0x20. The launcher and GetActiveSideName use this exact sign split.
selection_and_identity.trending_side_rule: record+0x28 is the engine trending-side definition. It is distinct from the active side and must be joined independently.
selection_and_identity.active_range_rule: record+0xb0 is the already engine-selected active-range definition. Capturing that identity closes shared-threshold equality without replay-side range selection.

transition_producer_route.law: Open/show refresh re-runs the first-match selector, hides the panel if the selected record is invalid, stores record/range at view+0x598/+0x5a0 and calls 0x141c4baa0 with a full refresh.
State-change refresh re-runs the selector, compares previous and current record/range pointers, then calls 0x141c4baa0 with exact full-versus-partial flags.

The terminal controller update writes the percentage, sprite, marker, effective icons and resolved names, refreshes range materialization when required, rebuilds decisions, and finally commits the active-range indicator frame.

bar_state.consequence: A moving sprite encodes trend direction, not current active side.

change_rate.numeric: 0x140e41430 resolves each country handle in record+0x38/count+0x44 and returns sum(modifier type 0x98)*7 + sum(type 0x99).
change_rate.resolved_text: 0x140e420b0 selects BOP_CHANGE_RATE_WEEKLY only when the normalized daily and weekly sums cancel to zero; otherwise it selects BOP_CHANGE_RATE_DAILY and formats the exact fixed-point magnitude.
change_rate.direction: negative is left, positive is right, zero is stable

presentation_laws.effective_icons: 0x140e42780 first checks the selected record's +0x178/count+0x184 override rows by authored side id; otherwise it uses side_definition+0x38, then evaluates the resulting scripted-localisation string in current country scope.
presentation_laws.range_indicator: 0x141c498d0 walks record+0x68/count+0x74 in stored order, computes final widget positions from exact fixed-point bounds and live GUI geometry, maps range-definition pointer to indicator, and writes frame 2 for record+0xb0 and frame 1 for all others. The carrier's zero-based frame field therefore requires normalization from engine frame 1/2, not direct copying.
presentation_laws.range_splitters: 0x141c495a0 clears the prior splitter vector and materializes subsequent stored-order range boundaries into view+0x628/count+0x634.

modifier_binding.producer: 0x140e422e0 calls the generic modifier-description formatter on record+0xc8 first for type 0x98, appends one newline when needed, then appends type 0x99.
modifier_binding.exact_surface: The UI consumes one resolved aggregate modifier-description string. It does not expose an authenticated ordered array of modifier ids/source rows.
modifier_binding.schema_consequence: Replace active_modifiers_complete plus active_modifiers[] with one required A25-resolved power_balance_modifier_desc_text_ref. Do not attempt to reconstruct row identities from D67 or parse the final localized text.

decision_binding.category_join: selected_record+0x10 balance definition supplies its decision category at definition+0x38
decision_binding.visibility: Each family applies selected balance/category membership, runtime gate 0x140724770 and its family visibility function before materialization.
decision_binding.final_order: All materialized presenter pointers are combined, exact-sorted by 0x141c474b0/0x141c475a0 using comparator 0x141c48340, then inserted into decision_grid by 0x141c48550.
decision_binding.comparator: selected category first; descending category/order rank from 0x140721690; descending definition integer at +0x968; ascending presenter ordinal at +0x520
decision_binding.capture_boundary: Capture the sorted pointer list immediately before 0x141c48550 insertion or enumerate the finalized decision_grid and join each presenter to its stable definition id and exact runtime text/state leaves.
